papers.title: DECONVersation: Single Cell Foundation Model-Derived Embeddings for Robust Cell Type Deconvolution of Bulk RNA-seq
papers.abstract: AI and deep learning have transformed single-cell transcriptomics, empowering unsupervised annotation, trajectory inference, and cross-dataset integration at scale. Here, we propose bulk RNA-seq deconvolution as a novel task for single-cell foundation models. Deconvolution estimates cell type proportions from bulk RNA-seq using single-cell reference data, with applications spanning tumor microenvironment profiling to the detection of disease-associated shifts in tissue composition. However, existing methods remain vulnerable to batch effects, subject-level variation, and marker gene selection sensitivity. We introduce DECONVersation, which leverages embeddings from pretrained and fine-tuned single-cell foundation models, coupled with a non-negative least squares solver, to estimate cell type proportions. Foundation model embeddings are robust to batch effects and implicitly encode complex gene relationships, sidestepping explicit marker gene selection. Benchmarked against MuSiC, DWLS, and BayesPrism, DECONVersation achieved comparable or superior performance across diverse tissues. Performance further improved with tissue-specific fine-tuning.

summary.takeaway: 提出DECONVersation，将单细胞基础模型嵌入用于bulk RNA-seq细胞类型解卷积，减少对标记基因选择的依赖。
summary.methods: 利用预训练与微调的单细胞基础模型生成嵌入，结合非负最小二乘求解器估计细胞类型比例；与MuSiC、DWLS、BayesPrism在多种组织上对比。
summary.relevance: 属于细胞基础模型与预训练方向，探索基础模型嵌入在解卷积新任务中的迁移应用。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅给出相对比较结论，未提供具体数据集、细胞类型或定量提升幅度；组织特异性微调的效果需原文数据支撑。

papers.title: STEER-seq: a recombinase based platform for pooled multimodal single-cell perturbation screening
papers.abstract: Pooled gain-of-function screening is a powerful method for screening for transcription factors whose overexpression leads to changes in cellular identity. However, variable transgene copy number, integration site and genomic context from random viral integration can confound quantitative comparisons between perturbations. We present STEER-seq (Single-cell Transgene Expression via Exchange Recombination sequencing), a virus-free platform for pooled ORF gain-of-function screening in human induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSCs). STEER-seq combines irreversible Bxb1-mediated integration at a defined genomic safe-harbour locus with promoterless donor libraries and barcode-enabled perturbation tracking, enabling single-copy expression from a common promoter and genomic context and direct recovery of perturbation identity by single-cell sequencing. In a focused haematopoietic screen, SPI1 expression alone was sufficient to drive differentiation towards HSC/MPP-like progenitors in the absence of exogenous cytokines, with transient induction generating progenitors that retained multilineage haematopoietic differentiation potential. Joint RNA-chromatin accessibility profiling linked transcription factor-induced transcriptional responses to chromatin remodelling and enabled reconstruction of perturbation-induced gene regulatory networks, including a RUNX2-driven osteoblast programme. Scaling STEER-seq to around 2,000 human coding sequences enabled systematic discovery of transcription factors capable of inducing distinct cell-state programmes, including neural progenitor-, melanocyte- and vascular smooth muscle-like states, as well as maintenance of pluripotency. STEER-seq provides a scalable, quantitative framework for single-cell and multimodal gain-of-function screening, enabling functional discovery and engineering of human cell identity.

summary.takeaway: 提出STEER-seq，一种基于重组酶的无病毒平台，实现单拷贝、位点明确的pooled多模态单细胞功能获得筛选。
summary.methods: 在hiPSCs的基因组安全港位点通过Bxb1介导不可逆整合，使用无启动子供体文库与条形码追踪；在造血筛选中结合RNA与染色质可及性联合分析，并扩展至约2000个人类编码序列。
summary.relevance: 直接涉及单细胞扰动、多组学扰动及GRN/Regulon重建。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告筛选的假阳性率、检测灵敏度等定量指标；安全港位点单拷贝表达是否完全模拟内源调控仍需原文验证。

papers.title: Latent causal diffusions for single-cell perturbation modeling.
papers.abstract: Perturbation screens hold the potential to systematically map regulatory processes at single-cell resolution, yet modeling and predicting transcriptome-wide responses to perturbations remains a major computational challenge. Existing methods often underperform simple baselines, fail to disentangle measurement noise from biological signal, and provide limited insight into the causal structure governing cellular responses. Here, we present the latent causal diffusion (LCD), a generative model that frames single-cell gene expression as a stationary diffusion process observed under measurement noise. LCD outperforms established approaches in predicting the distributional shifts of unseen perturbation combinations in single-cell RNA-sequencing screens while simultaneously learning a mechanistic dynamical system of gene regulation. To interpret these learned dynamics, we develop an approach we call causal linearization via perturbation responses (CLIPR), which yields an approximation of the direct causal effects between all genes modeled by the diffusion. CLIPR provably identifies causal effects under a linear drift assumption and recovers causal structure in both simulated systems and a genome-wide perturbation screen, where it clusters genes into coherent functional modules and resolves causal relationships that standard differential expression analysis cannot. The LCD-CLIPR framework bridges generative modeling with causal inference to predict unseen perturbation effects and map the underlying regulatory mechanisms of the transcriptome.
papers.venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

summary.takeaway: 提出潜因果扩散模型LCD及CLIPR解释方法，用于预测未见扰动组合的分布偏移并推断基因调控因果结构。
summary.methods: 将单细胞基因表达建模为测量噪声下的平稳扩散过程，学习机制性动力系统；CLIPR在线性漂移假设下近似基因间直接因果效应，并在模拟系统与全基因组扰动筛选中验证。
summary.relevance: 契合单细胞扰动建模与机制推理主题，连接生成模型与因果推断。
summary.caveat: CLIPR的因果识别依赖线性漂移假设，实际生物系统中的适用性需进一步检验；摘要未给出具体性能数值或基线对比细节。

papers.title: KRAKEN: A provenance-tracked knowledge graph for multiomic and wellness research
papers.abstract: Existing general-purpose biomedical knowledge graphs tend to focus on disease mechanisms and drug repurposing, leaving multiomic and wellness-relevant content underrepresented. KRAKEN (Knowledge Research & Analysis Kit for Evidence Networks) addresses this gap by integrating existing graphs (including Translator KG Open, RTX-KG2, and ROBOKOP) with specialized sources such as RefMet, LIPID MAPS, NIH Common Data Elements, Polygenic Score Catalog, and derived wellness measures including biological age and biological BMI. The resulting graph spans ~26M nodes and ~121M edges across 62 entity types. KRAKEN adopts the Biolink Model as its semantic layer, ensuring compatibility with standardized resources emerging from the NIH NCATS Biomedical Data Translator program. A lightweight, modular build system rebuilds the full graph (including entity resolution), with peak memory consumption under 48 GB, and supports flexible inclusion or exclusion of sources, allowing the user to scope the graph to a domain of interest. Built-in analytical tools include multi-hop reasoning, subgraph extraction, text, vector and hybrid entity search, and enrichment analyses, all accessible through an interactive web interface, a REST API, and a Model Context Protocol server, the last enabling direct consumption by agentic and LLM-based systems. KRAKEN is freely available at https://app.krakenkg.com.

summary.takeaway: 构建KRAKEN知识图谱，整合多组学与健康相关内容，支持多跳推理、搜索和富集分析，并提供面向LLM/agent的MCP服务。
summary.methods: 整合Translator KG Open、RTX-KG2、ROBOKOP及RefMet、LIPID MAPS、NIH Common Data Elements、Polygenic Score Catalog等来源，采用Biolink Model语义层，模块化构建约2600万节点、1.21亿边的图。
summary.relevance: 属于知识图谱方向，面向多组学与健康研究的检索增强和推理基础设施。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告图质量评估、实体解析准确率或下游任务表现；由多源整合带来的覆盖偏差未量化。

papers.title: Probing Genomic Foundation Models with Splice-Variant Perturbations
papers.abstract: As benchmarks saturate, traditional validation methods fail to capture the probabilistic representations of genomic foundation models. This study probes self-supervised generalists (NTv3 650M, Evo2 40B, Genos 10B) alongside task-specific specialists (SpliceAI, AlphaGenome, Borzoi) using a mechanistically focused paradigm centered on expert-curated single-nucleotide substitutions within the splicing regions of the exon-rich OPA1 gene. Extending this analysis across the broader corpus of OPA1 mutations, variants of uncertain significance (VUS), and an independent 65-gene dataset of spliceogenic mutations demonstrates that generalists can match task-specific networks. Training data scale, genetic diversity, and evolutionary context are key for capturing RNA splicing syntax, whereas sparse routing may constrain performance. Mechanistically, foundation models exhibit a compute-asymmetry: the Evo2 40B model frontloads compute into massive parameter scale to resolve single-nucleotide variants within a narrow 425-bp context window, whereas the bidirectional NTv3 650M model and the Genos 10B mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture backload compute to inference, requiring spatial logit aggregation and expansive context windows of up to 94 kb. Furthermore, classification accuracy across these foundation models benefitted from locus-specific thresholding rather than mutation-class calibration, exposing representation boundaries of the models.

summary.takeaway: 通过剪接区单核苷酸变异扰动探测基因组基础模型，发现通用模型在部分任务上可媲美专用模型，并揭示计算分配差异。
summary.methods: 使用专家整理OPA1剪接区变异、VUS及独立65基因剪接突变数据集，评估NTv3 650M、Evo2 40B、Genos 10B与SpliceAI、AlphaGenome、Borzoi。
summary.relevance: 属于预训练基因组基础模型评估方向，考察其对剪接语法的表征能力。
summary.caveat: 摘要为定性结论，未给出各模型具体指标；仅基于剪接相关变异，结论不一定推广至其他基因组任务。

papers.title: Biohybrid toggle switches: leveraging bistability in muscle-actuated machines
papers.abstract: Tissue-engineered skeletal muscle offers robotics unique advantages in energy density, adaptability, and self-repair, but current biohybrid machines couple muscle directly to artificial skeletons, limiting net force output and requiring continuous stimulation maintain mechanism positions. Here, we introduce a biohybrid bistable switching mechanism that converts antagonistic muscle contractions to snap-through actuation of an elastomeric four-bar flexure, maintaining stable positions without energy consumption. We decouple passive muscle pre-tensioning from flexure operation with thin-film elastomer resistance bands, enabling fine tuning of spring stiffness and force to match muscle mechanical output envelopes. Leveraging mesoscale additive manufacturing, spin coating, and replica molding techniques, components are integrated into a millimeter-scale linear stage to axially align muscles with artificial components. Our prototype achieves reversible toggling between bistable states with a 130 ms switching time, establishing skeletal muscle actuators as viable electromechanical switches, and broadening biohybrid robotics towards novel applications such as grippers, valves, and mechanical computers.

summary.takeaway: 提出基于骨骼肌驱动的生物混合双稳态开关机构，可在无持续能耗下维持稳定位置。
summary.methods: 利用弹性体四杆柔性机构将拮抗肌肉收缩转化为突跳驱动，通过薄膜弹性带解耦预张力与柔性机构，结合中尺度增材制造、旋涂和复制模塑集成毫米级线性平台。
summary.relevance: matched_topics为检索增强与对齐，但摘要内容为生物混合机器人，与该主题无直接关联，属匹配异常。
summary.caveat: 摘要只报告130 ms切换时间与可逆切换，未提供疲劳寿命、输出力或长期稳定性数据；与所列主题不相关。

papers.title: Anti-target chemical-space coverage of Indian medicinal plant phytochemicals
papers.abstract: Computational safety evaluation of phytochemical libraries commonly relies on models trained on experimentally tested compounds and applied to much larger and chemically diverse collections. An important but often overlooked question is whether predicted compounds are adequately represented within the experimental chemical space underlying these models. Here, we examined this question for the Indian Medicinal Plants, Phytochemistry and Therapeutics (IMPPAT) database using experimentally characterized datasets for three anti-target endpoints: hERG blockade, cytochrome P450 (CYP) inhibition, and pregnane X receptor (PXR) induction. After structure standardization, 14,956 unique IMPPAT compounds were compared with 8,877 hERG, 4,905 CYP, and 4,138 PXR reference compounds using consensus nearest-neighbor similarity based on Morgan and atom-pair fingerprints. At a Tanimoto similarity threshold of 0.80, only 0.92%, 0.30%, and 0.46% of IMPPAT compounds had close measured analogs in the hERG, CYP, and PXR datasets, respectively. Relative to the internal nearest-neighbor distributions of the reference datasets, a typical IMPPAT compound lay near the 1st percentile, indicating substantial chemical-space separation. Compounds with close experimental analogs also showed distinct molecular characteristics, with descriptor-based logistic regression yielding cross-validated AUC values of 0.77-0.80. Plant-level enrichment was markedly reduced after excluding widely distributed metabolites and was further restricted when the nearest measured analog was required to have pIC50 or pEC50 [≥] 5. The remaining signals were concentrated in a limited number of taxa, including Rauvolfia, Sinopodophyllum/Dysosma, Cinchona, and Catharanthus roseus. Overall, most IMPPAT phytochemicals lack close structural representation among currently measured anti-target compounds. Computational safety predictions for these molecules should therefore be interpreted as extrapolations and accompanied by explicit measures of structural support. Absence of a close experimental analog should be regarded as a gap in available evidence rather than evidence of safety.

summary.takeaway: 评估IMPPAT植物化学物在hERG、CYP、PXR抗靶点实验化学空间中的覆盖度，指出多数化合物缺乏近邻实验类似物。
summary.methods: 标准化结构后，将14,956个IMPPAT化合物与8,877个hERG、4,905个CYP、4,138个PXR参考化合物，用Morgan与原子对指纹的最近邻相似性比较；并做描述符逻辑回归与植物层级富集分析。
summary.relevance: matched_topics为检索增强与对齐，实质涉及计算安全预测的适用域与证据覆盖问题。
summary.caveat: 仅基于结构相似性判断覆盖度，不评估功能相似性；摘要指出多数化合物预测应视为外推，但未验证外推预测本身的准确性。

papers.title: Ecological coupling of foraging and thermoregulation in harvester ants from a tropical deciduous forest in southern Mexico
papers.abstract: Diurnal ectotherms in hot and dry ecosystems face an acquisition trade-off between maximizing collective energy intake and minimizing individual exposure time. We employed optimal foraging and thermoregulation models to examine the surface foraging and thermoregulatory strategies of Pogonomyrmex barbatus foragers in response to habitat warming in a tropical deciduous forest. Foraging activity was evaluated using field-based thermal performance curves (fTPCs) for individual foraging speed and collective foraging success. Thermoregulation was assessed through indices of thermal unsuitability, as well as thermoregulatory effectiveness and exploitation. Our results show that afternoon conditions were significantly hotter and drier than those in the morning. Furthermore, the decoupling of fTPCs was dynamic; while the optimal temperature (Topt) for individual foraging speed remained stable at 44 degrees C, the Topt for collective foraging success shifted from 35 degrees C in the morning to 41 degrees C in the afternoon. This shift in foraging strategy, driven by stressful afternoon conditions, was reflected in a transition of the thermoregulatory strategy. Specifically, the probability of foraging activity decreased as thermal unsuitability increased, with a lower baseline in the afternoon. The thermoregulatory exploitation dropped from 94% in the morning to 63% in the afternoon. Based on thermoregulatory effectiveness, foragers transitioned from an active thermoregulatory strategy in the morning to a thermoconformist strategy in the afternoon while foraging on the surface. So, the observed colonies optimized the balance between individual foraging speed and collective foraging success through a thermoregulatory strategy that was primarily spatial in the morning and strictly temporal in the afternoon. A comparison with historical data from the same site reveals a 40% contraction in the total daily foraging window since 2013.

summary.takeaway: 研究墨西哥南部热带落叶林收获蚁觅食与体温调节的生态耦合，发现午后热胁迫下觅食策略由空间调节转向时间调节。
summary.methods: 使用最优觅食与体温调节模型，结合个体觅食速度与群体觅食成功的野外热性能曲线，以及热不适宜、体温调节有效性与利用度指标。
summary.relevance: matched_topics为检索增强与对齐，与摘要的生态学内容无直接关联，属匹配异常。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明样本量、年份或统计效应量；40%觅食窗口收缩基于与历史数据比较，混杂因素未在摘要中讨论，且与所列主题不相关。

papers.title: Gene Regulatory Network Reconstruction to Decipher the Molecular Mechanisms Governing Bacteriocyte-Based Symbioses.
papers.abstract: Intracellular bacteria with beneficial roles for their hosts are present in more than 10% of all insect species. In intracellular nutritional symbioses, these symbionts are typically confined to specialized host cells known as bacteriocytes. Bacteriocytes are remarkable novel cells that arose independently and repeatedly across multiple insect lineages. They are fascinating structures, yet the molecular mechanisms regulating their development, function and even their evolutionary origins, remain largely unknown. Nonetheless, an important role for certain transcription factors in development and homeostasis of bacteriocytes has been highlighted by several studies, hinting at the importance of the transcriptional networks regulated by them. Gene Regulatory Network (GRN) inference facilitates discovery of regulatory interactions underlying complex biological processes, as first shown in the model species Drosophila melanogaster and subsequently successfully applied to several other insect species. Here, we propose de novo computational inference as a strategy to reconstruct GRNs of bacteriocytes. We propose that the pea aphid Acyrthosiphon pisum is best suited to establish the first comparative framework for reconstructing and analyzing GRNs that control bacteriocyte development, function and death. This framework in turn can serve for evo-devo studies, by extending these analyses to other aphids, to other hemipterans and, more broadly, to other insects harboring bacteriocytes.

summary.takeaway: 提出用从头计算推断重建蚜虫bacteriocyte的基因调控网络，以解析胞内共生菌相关细胞的发育、功能与死亡机制。
summary.methods: 综述与框架性提议，未做新实验；建议以豌豆蚜Acyrthosiphon pisum为模型，利用GRN推断方法重建bacteriocyte调控网络，并扩展到其他蚜虫、半翅目及含bacteriocyte的昆虫。
summary.relevance: 直接对应GRN/Regulon主题，讨论如何用计算推断获取调控相互作用，并以bacteriocyte为对象建立比较性GRN框架。
summary.caveat: 摘要为观点/框架文章，未提供具体数据集、推断算法或验证结果，也未给出任何重建成功的实证。

papers.title: High-throughput identification of chromatin-opening transcription factors
papers.abstract: Cell fate transitions involve major changes to the chromatin landscape, some of which are thought to deepen the basin around a newly adopted cell state, stabilizing gene expression programs that might otherwise be transient. Transcription factors (TFs) are central to this process, binding a subset of their genome-wide motif occurrences to create accessible regions that can act as cell type-specific enhancers. However, apart from a few well-studied cases, it is not clear which of the ~1,600 mammalian TFs, when newly expressed, can directly or indirectly initiate newly accessible sites, nor why only some motif occurrences gain accessibility. Here, we applied pooled CRISPR activation (CRISPRa) to upregulate endogenous TFs to physiological levels in mouse embryonic stem cells (mESCs). After screening guides targeting 240 developmental TFs for transcriptional response, we selected 60 and jointly profiled gene expression and chromatin accessibility in ~140,000 single cells. Some TFs (e.g. Cdx2, Sox10) appeared to initiate new accessibility on their own, predominantly at distal sites that are closed in mESCs but coincide with cell type-specific enhancers later in development. Others appeared to partner with "co-TFs", either by leveraging preexisting mESC heterogeneity (e.g. {uparrow}Grhl1 in Tfap2c+ mESCs [->] opening of sites bearing motifs for both), or by hierarchical activation (e.g. {uparrow}Sox7 [->] {uparrow}Gata6 [->] opening of sites bearing either or both motifs). Such dependencies shape which sites are used and which fates are reachable, and may explain the differential behavior of TFs with nearly identical consensus motifs. Thus, the capacity of a newly expressed TF to open chromatin strongly depends on the cell type, cell state and gene regulatory network it lands in. Charting these dependencies will inform how cell fate transitions are initiated in development, homeostasis and disease, and how to engineer them in silico, in vitro and in vivo.

summary.takeaway: 系统筛查240个发育相关转录因子，发现新表达TF能否打开染色质高度依赖细胞状态与已有调控网络，部分TF需依赖共TF或层级激活。
summary.methods: 在小鼠胚胎干细胞mESCs中用pooled CRISPRa将内源TF上调至生理水平，先筛240个发育TF的转录响应，选出60个，在约14万个单细胞中联合分析基因表达与染色质可及性。
summary.relevance: 与GRN/Regulon直接相关，揭示TF、共TF和既有GRN如何决定染色质开放与细胞命运可达性；也涉及单细胞多组学与调控网络推断。
summary.caveat: 未提供摘要中具体TF的完整列表与统计细节；结论基于mESCs单一细胞背景，其他细胞类型与体内情形尚不确定。

papers.title: Single-cell gene networks nominate IKZF1 as an Alzheimer's disease microglial regulator.
papers.abstract: BackgroundMicroglia drive neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's disease (AD), yet no approved therapy targets this compartment. Human genome-wide association studies consistently implicate innate immune loci in AD risk, establishing microglial transcriptional programs as therapeutically relevant but pharmacologically underexploited targets.ObjectiveWe sought to identify transcription factors (TFs) governing microglial state transitions computationally and to nominate structurally tractable drug repurposing candidates.MethodsWe applied trajectory inference (PAGA), pseudobulk DESeq2, pySCENIC gene regulatory network (GRN) inference, CellChat, and virtual screening of 1962 approved compounds to 236,002 microglial nuclei from 84 donors (SEA-AD atlas).ResultsIKZF1 was the sole target TF retained under cisTarget v10 motif constraints, with peak regulon activity in LateAD-DAM (pseudotime ρ = + 0.309) and replication in an independent bulk cohort (GSE95587; adjusted p = 0.004). CellChat identified SLIT2→ROBO2 from multiple neuron subtypes (predominantly inhibitory interneurons) as the top predicted pathway to microglia. Tafamidis (→IRF8) and diflunisal (→PPARG) were top virtual screening hits; all evaluated compounds failed the pre-specified selectivity threshold.ConclusionsIKZF1 is prioritized as a candidate late-disease microglial TF, supported by six convergent evidence dimensions including independent bulk replication. Tafamidis and diflunisal are low-confidence repurposing hypotheses requiring experimental validation.

summary.takeaway: 通过单细胞调控网络分析将IKZF1提名为阿尔茨海默病晚期微胶质细胞状态的候选调控因子，并进行药物再利用虚拟筛选。
summary.methods: 对SEA-AD图谱84名供体的236,002个微胶质细胞核应用PAGA轨迹推断、pseudobulk DESeq2、pySCENIC GRN推断、CellChat以及1962个已批准化合物的虚拟筛选；并在独立bulk队列GSE95587中复制。
summary.relevance: 直接涉及GRN/Regulon，使用pySCENIC从单细胞数据推断调控网络并提名关键TF。
summary.caveat: 候选药物均未通过预设选择性阈值，Tafamidis与diflunisal仅为低置信度再利用假设，需实验验证；IKZF1也仍是计算提名而非功能验证结论。

papers.title: Archetype analysis of multiplexed antibody imaging reveals interpretable morphological programs in optical pooled screens
papers.abstract: High-content imaging-based screens with small molecule or genetic perturbations rely on rich optical phenotypes, yet how distinct subcellular markers contribute complementary biological information remains unclear. Here, we introduce CellMAPP, a multiplexed organelle imaging platform that uses optical pooled screens with iterative antibody staining to map cellular architecture under perturbation. Using 17 markers across 524 genetic perturbations in MCF-7 cells, we systematically examined how individual, and combinations of, markers capture diverse morphological responses. We find that markers provide complementary views of perturbation effects, with increased multiplexing improving signal and the breadth of hit recovery, although some phenotypes are better recovered from a subset of features rather than a full profile. Because non-molecular image-based profiles can be challenging to link with interpretable biology, we developed CHART (available at https://github.com/Genentech/CHART), an archetype analysis framework that identifies distinct reference morphological states for each marker and uses multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to automatically annotate them, connecting cellular images to recognizable organelle phenotypes. Integrating archetypes across multiple markers revealed modular morphological programs that describe coordinated organelle reorganization in response to perturbation. This framework identified regulators of defined organelle states such as micronuclei, nominated novel gene functions and revealed complex patterns of multi-organelle reposition. Together, optical profiling with MAPP and CHART provides an interpretable, scalable framework for image-based screens that sheds light on rules governing cellular structural reprogramming.

summary.takeaway: 提出CellMAPP多重细胞器成像平台与CHART原型分析框架，用多模态大语言模型自动注释形态原型，解析扰动下协调的细胞器重塑程序。
summary.methods: 在MCF-7细胞中对524个遗传扰动进行光学pooled筛选和迭代抗体染色，使用17个标志物；开发CHART，针对每个标志物识别参考形态状态，并用MLLM自动注释，整合多标志物原型。
summary.relevance: 涉及大语言模型与多模态学习在图像筛选解释中的应用，同时关联扰动响应和细胞形态程序的发现。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明筛选灵敏度、脱靶或生物学验证的详细程度；CHART注释依赖MLLM，可能受模型偏差影响，摘要未量化其准确性。

papers.title: A High-Content Pseudotime Framework for Morphological Profiling of Dengue Virus Inhibitors from a Drug-Repurposing Library
papers.abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) causes dengue fever, a globally prevalent, epidemic-prone disease with no FDA-approved antivirals. Additionally, the available vaccine for DENV can increase the risk of severe dengue fever for those who have never had a DENV infection due to antibody-dependent enhancement. Thus, there is an urgent need to identify DENV antivirals. Drug repurposing, high-content screening, and machine learning were leveraged to efficiently identify antivirals likely to inhibit DENV replication. Using high-content screening in a DENV infection model, we characterized the morphological patterns of NS4B and envelope (E) protein expression over time and developed a viral pseudotime model that predicts infection progression to aid in phenotypic interpretation of drug effects. We then developed a single cell infection classifier for antiviral efficacy and performed high-throughput drug screening of 960 compounds. We identified four concentration-dependent inhibitors of DENV with nanomolar-to-submicromolar potencies: esomeprazole, GW4064, pralatrexate, and LY411575. With our pseudotime machine learning model trained on data from the time-series assay, we scored the concentration-dependent inhibitors to map their mechanism of action onto time points in the viral life cycle. Our most notable results show that LY411575, a gamma secretase inhibitor, exhibited an IC of 72 nM and reduced percent infection to near the level of the mock infection control. Pseudotime inferences generated mechanistic predictions that were supported by time-of-addition experiments, indicating that LY411575 arrests DENV infection before the development of late-stage infection associated morphologies, while retaining activity when added after inoculation.

summary.takeaway: 结合高内涵筛选、病毒假时间模型和单细胞感染分类器，从960个化合物中鉴定出四个浓度依赖性登革病毒抑制剂，并用假时间推断其作用阶段。
summary.methods: 在DENV感染模型中高内涵成像NS4B与包膜蛋白表达，建立病毒假时间模型预测感染进程；训练单细胞感染分类器，筛选960个药物再利用化合物，并用时间加药实验验证预测。
summary.relevance: 属于药物扰动机制与表型筛选主题，同时使用机器学习模型对药物作用机制进行时序定位。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告四个抑制剂及LY411575的IC50与效果，未提供其他化合物的完整筛选指标；机制预测主要基于假时间和时间加药实验，尚需进一步机制验证。

papers.title: Structured biological evidence enables general-purpose language models to predict bacteriophage-host interactions
papers.abstract: Biological interaction inference often requires integrating heterogeneous evidence that differs in biological meaning, provenance, specificity, and reliability. Existing computational approaches typically compress such evidence into numerical features, aggregate scores, or latent representations before prediction, obscuring the contribution of individual evidence records and limiting interpretation when evidence is conflicting or incomplete. Phage-host interaction prediction provides a demanding test case for this problem, requiring the integration of genomic, functional, and reference-derived evidence with differing coverage, specificity, and reliability. Here we introduce a structured-evidence inference paradigm that retains heterogeneous biological observations as modular, named, and experimentally perturbable records rather than compressing them before prediction. We implement this paradigm in PHI-Reason, which constructs structured textual profiles from genomic annotations, receptor-binding protein homology, nucleotide-neighbour relationships, alignment-free genomic similarity, and available CRISPR spacer information. A general-purpose large language model (LLM) performs inference directly over these structured profiles without task-specific training or manually engineered evidence-fusion rules. Across phage-host benchmarks, PHI-Reason achieved species-level top-1 accuracies of 67.4% and 57.2% on RefSeq-634 and VHDB-3150, respectively, and a multi-host accuracy of 0.673 on the Hi-C cohort, outperforming established numerical methods. On 207 experimentally supported associations from 2025-2026 excluded from the reference corpus, it achieved 52.2% species-level and 90.8% genus-level top-1 accuracy. Evidence perturbations identified nucleotide-neighbour context as the dominant signal and quantified complementary or misleading evidence contributions. Target-conditioned local Jacobian and output-grounding analyses further characterized evidence-dependent inference and departures of generated rationales from the supplied evidence. Extending the framework to eukaryotic virus-host prediction preserved high predictive accuracy (67.0%), supporting cross-domain portability. Moreover, replacing the reasoning LLM with Jev, a typed-decision model, maintained broadly comparable performance across phage-host benchmarks while reducing mean per-query inference time by 11- to 40-fold, supporting the separation of evidence representation from downstream inference. These results establish structured biological evidence as a portable interface between heterogeneous biological observations and downstream inference. By separating evidence representation from the inference engine, this paradigm supports both language-model predictions with inspectable rationales and faster typed decisions for high-throughput prediction, while making the contribution and limits of evidential support directly testable.

summary.takeaway: 提出结构化证据推断范式PHI-Reason，将异质生物学证据保留为可扰动记录并交由通用LLM直接推理，用于噬菌体-宿主相互作用预测。
summary.methods: 构建包含基因组注释、受体结合蛋白同源、核苷酸邻近关系、无对齐基因组相似性和CRISPR spacer等信息的结构化文本档案；用通用LLM无需任务训练进行预测，并在RefSeq-634、VHDB-3150、Hi-C队列及207个新实验关联上评估，还做证据扰动与Jacobian分析。
summary.relevance: 直接结合大语言模型与检索增强/对齐式证据整合，强调证据表示与推理引擎分离，支持可检查理由和高通量预测。
summary.caveat: 表现虽优于数值方法，但物种级top-1准确率仍有限；生成的理由可能偏离所提供证据，摘要也指出需进一步检验证据贡献与限制。

papers.title: Characterization of artificial riboswitches for Coxsackievirus B3 detection using machine learning
papers.abstract: With the increase of recycled water to offset water demand, the potential possibility to spread contagious RNA viruses, such as Coxsackievirus B3, increases. However, detection of viral particles remains challenging because of low viral concentrations in wastewater and high mutation rates of the RNA virus. Robust monitoring is needed with low cost and low infrastructure technologies to increase accessibility of monitoring technologies worldwide. Novel viral detection methods have been developed, based on synthetic riboswitches that bind to the target virus and trigger a reporter gene, thus amplifying the detection signals. Such monitoring technologies can leverage machine learning to optimize the candidate nucleic acid sequences used for detection. To support the design of effective riboswitches, we present a machine learning model for classifying riboswitch performance, integrating RNA sequence data with secondary structural features based on free energy calculations and parameters that represent single strandedness. This model uses a sparsely gated Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture to route sequence and thermodynamic features to specialized experts, achieving strong generalization performance across cross-validation and held-out testing. When evaluated against baseline Decision Tree, Random Forest, Gaussian Naive Bayes, and Dense Neural Network classifiers, the MoE model demonstrated near-zero classification errors. Furthermore, post-hoc feature importance and k-mer analyzes reveal that near-perfect predictive performance in silico is strongly driven by sequence constructs in addition to generalizable folding mechanics. An ablation study of numerical feature and sequence inputs showed that while the Dense Neural Network also achieved high accuracy across all ablation conditions, the MoE architecture was retained as the primary model because its specialized subnetworks do not require all model parameters to be activated offering a potential computational advantage.

summary.takeaway: 构建基于稀疏门控MoE的机器学习模型，整合序列与热力学结构特征，用于分类人工核糖开关对Coxsackievirus B3的检测性能。
summary.methods: 整合RNA序列数据、基于自由能计算的结构特征和单链性参数，训练稀疏门控Mixture of Experts模型，并与决策树、随机森林、高斯朴素贝叶斯和稠密神经网络比较；进行交叉验证、留出测试、消融与k-mer分析。
summary.relevance: 属于大语言模型与检索增强/对齐主题下的RNA检测与机器学习应用，强调用ML优化合成核糖开关候选序列。
summary.caveat: 摘要称MoE在in silico达到近零分类错误，但未给出具体准确率数值；性能主要由序列构造驱动，湿实验验证与废水真实样本中的低浓度检测可行性尚不明确。

papers.title: Fine-tuning genomic models on rare splicing events identifies a novel biomarker of TDP-43 pathology
papers.abstract: Genomic foundation models (GFMs) are pretrained on large genomic datasets, but their ability to predict rare disease-associated events after fine-tuning remains unclear. We tested this using TDP-43 cryptic exons, well characterized splicing events linked to neurodegenerative disease that are poorly represented in standard annotations. We compared the state-of-the-art GFM AlphaGenome with OpenSpliceAI, a specialized splice site prediction model. Fine-tuned OpenSpliceAI detected held-out cryptic exons in human and mouse and captured allele-specific splicing effects at the disease-associated UNC13A locus. In contrast, a splicing prediction head trained on AlphaGenome's frozen pretrained backbone failed to predict cryptic exons. Unfreezing and fine-tuning all model weights, however, enabled AlphaGenome to generalize to held-out data. To investigate cryptic splicing in cell types that are difficult to study experimentally, we applied fine-tuned OpenSpliceAI across the genome to study cell type-specific genes. This led to the identification of new cryptic splicing events in CLDN11 and ARHGAP23, which were subsequently validated in FTLD-TDP brain tissue. Notably, the cryptic exon in CLDN11 is predicted to generate a neoepitope that could serve as an oligodendrocyte-specific biomarker of TDP-43 pathology. Our results show that even a state-of-the-art GFM can fail to generalize to rare splicing events, even with substantial pretraining. However, both foundation and specialized models that learn to generalize to rare biological events can have broad applications in biological discovery and medicine.

summary.takeaway: 微调基因组基础模型可改善对罕见剪接事件的预测，并据此发现TDP-43病理相关的新隐秘剪接事件与潜在生物标志物。
summary.methods: 以TDP-43相关cryptic exon为测试，比较AlphaGenome与专用模型OpenSpliceAI；微调OpenSpliceAI并在人和小鼠留出数据中检测，分析UNC13A等位基因特异性剪接，再全基因组应用于细胞类型特异基因，并在FTLD-TDP脑组织中验证CLDN11和ARHGAP23事件。
summary.relevance: 对应预训练主题，检验基因组基础模型在罕见疾病相关事件上的微调与泛化能力，并推进生物发现。
summary.caveat: AlphaGenome仅冻结backbone加剪接头时失败，说明基础模型并非总能泛化到罕见事件；新隐秘剪接与neoepitope生物标志物主要来自计算预测加初步组织验证，临床效用尚待证实。

papers.title: Learning Interpretable Switching Dynamics in Shared Neural-Behavioral Latent Space
papers.abstract: Modern recording technologies enable simultaneous measurement of high-dimensional neural activity and rich behavioral variables, creating both an opportunity and a modeling challenge: identifying the shared latent structure that mediates the brain-behavior relationship and the underlying dynamics through which it evolves across behavioral states. Existing approaches focus on different parts of this challenge: shared representation learning methods identify neural-behavioral subspaces but typically do not model dynamical structure, while dynamical models capture temporal variation and discrete state transitions in neural activity, but do not explicitly disentangle shared neural-behavioral structure from modality-specific variability. We introduce Switching Shared Latent Dynamics (SSLD), a unified framework that learns a latent representation shared between neural activity and behavior and endows this shared space with nonlinear switching recurrent dynamics to reflect the hypothesis that behaviorally relevant neural representations exhibit structured dynamical changes across behavioral states. Complementary private latent variables capture modality-specific variability, providing a window into neural activity that does not directly interact with behavior. We evaluate SSLD on a simulated dataset and four diverse experimental datasets spanning species, brain regions, and recording modalities: monkey motor and premotor cortex during reaching, somatosensory cortex during a bump task, widefield calcium imaging across mouse dorsal cortex during (a) self-initiated decision-making and (b) spontaneous movements. Across all four datasets, SSLD accurately reconstructs neural and behavioral signals, recovers discrete states in the dynamics that align with experimentally defined behavioral epochs, and isolates behaviorally-relevant neural information in the shared latent while preserving private neural variability. Ablations confirm that shared representation learning, behavioral supervision, and switching dynamics each contribute to performance. SSLD offers an interpretable approach to modeling shared neural-behavioral dynamics that complements ongoing efforts toward foundation models for neuroscience.

summary.takeaway: 提出 SSLD 统一框架，在共享神经-行为潜空间中学习可解释的切换循环动力学，同时用私有潜变量捕捉模态特异变异性。
summary.methods: SSLD 联合学习神经活动与行为的共享潜表示，并赋予该共享空间非线性切换循环动力学；另设私有潜变量建模模态特异变异。在模拟数据集及四个实验数据集（猴运动与前运动皮层伸够任务、猴体感皮层 bump 任务、小鼠背侧皮层宽场钙成像的自发决策与自发运动）上评估，并做消融分析。
summary.relevance: 该工作属于自监督与表示学习方向，将共享表示学习与动力学建模结合，为神经科学基础模型提供可解释的潜空间建模思路，与预训练/表示学习主题直接相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅称 SSLD 准确重建信号、恢复与实验行为epoch对齐的离散状态并分离共享与私有信息，未给出具体性能数值或与其他方法的定量对比；消融仅说明各组件有贡献，未披露效应大小。

papers.title: Mapping transcriptional responses to cellular perturbations with RNA fingerprinting.
papers.abstract: Single-cell perturbation dictionaries measure how cells respond to genetic and chemical perturbations, creating the opportunity to assign causal interpretations to observational data. We introduce RNA fingerprinting, a statistical framework that maps transcriptional responses from new experiments onto reference perturbation dictionaries. RNA fingerprinting learns perturbation representations, or "fingerprints," from single-cell data, then probabilistically assigns query cells to one or more candidate perturbations. We benchmark on ground-truth datasets, demonstrating accurate assignments at single-cell resolution, scalability to genome-wide screens, and the ability to resolve combinatorial perturbations. We demonstrate broad utility across diverse biological settings: identifying context-specific regulators of p53 under ribosomal stress, characterizing dose-dependent drug mechanisms of action, and uncovering cytokine-driven B cell heterogeneity during secondary influenza infection in vivo. Together, these results establish RNA fingerprinting as a versatile framework for interpreting single-cell datasets by linking cellular states to their underlying perturbations.

summary.takeaway: 提出 RNA fingerprinting 统计框架，从单细胞数据学习扰动“指纹”表示，并将查询细胞概率性地分配给一个或多个候选扰动。
summary.methods: 从单细胞扰动字典数据学习扰动表示（fingerprints），对查询细胞做概率性扰动分配。在 ground-truth 数据集上基准测试，评估单细胞分辨率分配准确性、全基因组筛选的可扩展性及组合扰动解析能力；应用于 p53 在核糖体应激下的背景特异性调控因子识别、剂量依赖药物作用机制刻画，以及体内二次流感感染中细胞因子驱动的 B 细胞异质性分析。
summary.relevance: 直接对应单细胞扰动主题，提供将观测性单细胞数据映射到参考扰动字典、赋予因果解释的统计框架。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告基准测试的具体准确率或统计指标；所声称的“准确分配”“可扩展”“可解析组合扰动”均无摘要内数值支撑，且对参考字典覆盖范围的依赖未讨论。

papers.title: Empirical Bayes Estimation of Sample-Specific Correlation Networks for Cross-Sectional and Longitudinal Omics Data
papers.abstract: Sample-specific molecular networks, which capture how an individual's gene regulatory structure may deviate from the population as a whole, are important tools for understanding heterogeneity in health and disease. However, most existing methods either do not accommodate uncertainty quantification or cannot handle missing data, non-Gaussian modalities, and longitudinal structure common in modern multi-omic studies. For example, copy number alterations in cancer genomic studies are non-Gaussian and often only partially observed, and their regulatory effects on gene expression may vary substantially across patients, variation that a single, population-averaged network cannot capture. To address these challenges, we propose PRISM (Personalized Relational Inference via Sample-specific Modeling), an empirical Bayes framework for estimating sample-specific covariance matrices from cross-sectional and longitudinal multi-omic data. PRISM models each individual sample's covariance matrix as drawn from an inverse-Wishart prior whose parameters are estimated from the data and allowed to vary across subpopulations or evolve over time, yielding a closed-form posterior and edge-level uncertainty quantification, ensuring scalability to high-dimensional omics data. In simulation experiments, PRISM achieves point-estimate accuracy comparable to or better than existing methods, substantially improved uncertainty calibration under non-Gaussian marginals, and lower computational cost, while maintaining robust coverage under moderate missingness. We apply PRISM to a yeast cell-cycle time course dataset, recovering time-varying biologically meaningful regulatory relationships independently documented in literature, and to paired copy number and gene expression data from ovarian cancer patients, identifying copy-number-expression interactions associated with survival, including TFs HNF4G and PAX8 which have independent evidence of clinical relevance in this cancer.

summary.takeaway: 提出 PRISM，一个经验贝叶斯框架，用于从横断面和纵向多组学数据估计样本特异性协方差矩阵，并提供边级不确定性量化。
summary.methods: PRISM 将每个样本的协方差矩阵建模为来自逆 Wishart 先验的抽样，先验参数由数据估计并可随亚群变化或随时间演化，得到闭式后验与边级不确定性量化。在模拟实验中评估点估计精度、非高斯边际下的不确定性校准、计算成本及中等缺失下的覆盖；并应用于酵母细胞周期时间序列和卵巢癌患者的拷贝数-基因表达配对数据。
summary.relevance: 虽匹配主题标注为检索增强与对齐，但其核心是多组学样本特异性网络与不确定性量化，与表示学习/对齐技术在多组学异质性建模中的统计工具需求相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出模拟实验的具体指标数值或与现有方法的定量优劣比较；应用结果仅称恢复文献记录的时变调控关系及识别与生存相关的拷贝数-表达相互作用，未报告统计显著性、效应量或生存分析细节。

papers.title: Generative inverse design steers human hematopoietic cell fate in vitro
papers.abstract: Inverse design has advanced the discovery of molecules and materials. Yet it remains largely unexplored for steering cell fate, where inputs are continuous, combinatorial culture conditions and outputs are distributions of cell states. Human hematopoiesis, in which combinations and doses of growth factors steer stem cells toward each blood lineage, is a demanding test case. While forward models can evaluate discrete conditions, the vast combinatorial space renders searching for a specific, target-producing design an intractable inverse problem. Here, we introduce LabCompass, an inverse-modeling framework that optimizes experimental designs toward candidates expected to produce specified target cell states, using a flow-matching generative model guided by cellular phenotypes predicted by a forward surrogate. We applied LabCompass to primary human CD34+ in vitro cultures, where continuous cytokine and small-molecule parameters govern hematopoietic cell fate. In a lab-in-the-loop setting, we experimentally validated model-driven designs and used these measurements to update the model across four successive loops. LabCompass recovered established lineage-inducing designs, improved predictions with new data, and enriched target populations across lineages. Incorporating new parameters expanded the design space and enriched rare populations beyond initial reach. Across loops, we generated a 78-million-cell spectral flow cytometry dataset and identified distinct culture conditions converging on the same target cell states. Our results establish generative inverse modeling as a compelling paradigm for navigating high-dimensional, continuous experimental spaces, and demonstrate that virtual cell models should be judged not only by how accurately they predict cellular responses, but also by how effectively they guide experiments toward desired biological outcomes.

summary.takeaway: 提出 LabCompass 逆建模框架，用流匹配生成模型配合前向代理预测的细胞表型，在连续组合培养条件空间中优化实验设计以产生目标细胞状态。
summary.methods: LabCompass 使用流匹配生成模型，由前向代理模型预测细胞表型作为引导，优化实验设计。应用于原代人 CD34+ 体外培养，连续细胞因子与小分子参数调控造血细胞命运；采用 lab-in-the-loop 设置，在四个循环中实验验证模型设计并更新模型。
summary.relevance: 对应虚拟细胞主题，展示生成式逆设计用于导航高维连续实验空间，并主张虚拟细胞模型应同时以预测准确性和引导实验达到目标的能力来评判。
summary.caveat: 摘要称 recovered 已确立的谱系诱导设计、提升预测并富集目标群体，但未报告具体富集倍数、预测准确率或与基线的定量对比；78-million-cell 数据集的规模为摘要所述，但未说明其统计功效或技术噪声控制。
